integrity: The crown-specific theorem is proved from the standard anti-forcing/feedback-set correspondence. The embedded verifier independently checks the feedback-set computation, direct deletion definition for small orders, recurrence, spectrum, and extremal counts.
limitations: The theorem is specific to crown graphs. The literature comparison did not locate an equivalent crown-graph result, but an unindexed equivalent treatment under a matching-theoretic alias remains possible. Finite verification is a stress test rather than a proof.
title: Anti-forcing distribution of crown graphs
